Step 7: Adjust inputs to explore different scenarios.
formula_explanation: The Loan Tenure Calculator uses: Tenure (months) = −ln(1 − P×r/EMI) / ln(1+r) where P = principal, r = monthly rate, EMI = desired monthly payment. Solve for n given EMI, principal, and rate.. Each variable is derived from your inputs with Indian regulatory parameters.
